name: Neural Sparse Voxel Fields (NSVF)
aliases: Neural Sparse Voxel Fields (NSVF) Volume Rendering
definition: A neural scene representation method that extends NeRF ideas to a multi-resolution coarse-to-fine approach, single image to scene representation, and animated 3D objects by adding a time dimension. It uses a sparse voxel grid for spatial embedding.
summary: Neural Sparse Voxel Fields is a hybrid scene representation that accelerates free-viewpoint rendering by combining NeRF's implicit modeling with an explicit sparse voxel grid to restrict computations to non-empty space.
